verdict.rationale: Buzz documents in-app voice huddles: users and agents can "drop into voice huddles", and the relay "also hosts git + huddle audio". That is a native audio-call capability inside the app, but video calling is not evidenced, and nothing shows how a call is started from a specific channel or DM. Missing for 10: video call support, documented flow for starting a call from a channel or DM, 1:1 DM call evidence unambiguously tied to calls, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app
